portInfo.description: Port of Bodø states it collaborates with Visit Bodø and local tourism on sustainable cruise development and notes membership in Cruise Europe, Cruise Norway and Cruise Northern Norway and Svalbard (CNNS). The captured English cruise page does not publish a berth length/depth table, so this guide keeps the landing at port-area precision with null door GPS. Postal address Postboks 138, 8001 Bodø; visiting Bodøterminalen 4th floor, Rønvikleira; +47 75 55 10 80; firmapost@bodohavn.no.
